why: hook: people walking down the stream corridor. Words say highway, picture says water.

'underneath it, sealed under a concrete lid, there was a stream'

'paving over it was the cheap answer, then they built the freeway on top' — Gangnam-daero from above. Deliberately NOT the Bank of Korea junction of cut 2: 37870428/37971704 are the same intersection and would have read as a repeat. focusX/panSpan aim the window at the roadway: the default centred 70% pan opened on glass facade and only found the road at the very end.
'until 2003, they tore the freeway down' — stepping stones, the stream as a place again
the numbers land on close water and stone. Source is only 6s, so this cut is capped at 130 frames + 45 handle.

THESIS SHOT. Dusk, elevated: the stream below and the street lights above in one frame, which is exactly what 'three degrees cooler down here than the street up there' means. Only verified non-daylight Cheonggyecheon in the pool.
